name: m12-m13-explicit
description: Do the nineteen C fixes added in M13 change survival and progress compared with M12, with the starting policy held fixed? Both versions play normal (special modes off) and munchkin-class (depth-6 stair-climbing start for Warrior, Druid and Ranger), on the same 1,800 assigned starts at 100,000 turns. Read the within-profile version comparisons separately. This descriptive aggregate comparison cannot attribute an effect to an individual fix or discharge the per-mode debt in issue #87. Lunal-only measurements need evidence of mode entry and changed-branch execution first. Prepared only; dispatch is the owner’s call.
